items.title: 1.2 Graphical Representation of Software Systems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of graphical representation (PDF 19-20).

blocks.text: Software systems ki graphical representation (tasveeron ke zariye dikhana) ka matlab hai software system ke structure (banawat) aur behavior (system kaise chalta hai) ke mukhtalif pehlu diagrams ke zariye dikhana. Is se complex systems saada ho jate hain, aur developers aur stakeholders ke liye system ko samajhna, us par baat karna aur us ko sambhalna aasan ho jata hai. Unified Modeling Language (UML) jaise diagrams software ke mukhtalif components, un ke aapas ke rishte aur interactions (len den) dikhane ke liye bohat istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Software development mein diagrams kyun faidamand hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh complex system ko samajhna aasan banate hain, developers aur stakeholders ko baat karne ke liye ek jaisi tasveer dete hain, aur system ko sambhalne mein madad karte hain.

items: Graphical representation: system ka structure aur behavior diagrams se dikhana; samajhna, baat karna aur sambhalna aasan; UML diagrams aam hain.
